title: selliguea blumeana
intro: Selliguea blumeana, commonly known as the Water Clover or Polypodium, is a type of fern native to tropical Asia. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and lower blood pressure due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea blumeana include its anti-diarrheal, anti-ulcer, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Furthermore, the bioactive constituents of Selliguea blumeana also include glycosides, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
